description:
BEACH CLEANING DRIVE – MARVE & MANORI
A small step towards a cleaner environment, but a BIG effort by our young volunteers.
Youth Service of Rotary Club of Bombay Kandivli successfully conducted a Beach Cleaning Drive at Marve & Manori Beach in association with Rotaract Clubs, where Rotaractors collectively collected approximately 70 kg of waste, including plastic bottles, glass bottles, flowers and other waste.

We were proud to have 96 enthusiastic Rotaractors from 4 Rotaract Clubs
🔹 RCBK
🔹 Thakur College
🔹 G.D. Jalan College
🔹 Khandwala Club
These young volunteers came forward wholeheartedly and gave their time and energy to make a difference. Their enthusiasm and commitment were truly inspiring.
location: MARVE & MANORI Beach, Malad West, Mumbai, Maharashtra
